app.title: Nico Karaoke
player.idle.title: Turn on some music
player.idle.lead: Play a song in another app — YouTube in your browser, Spotify, any player you like. This window follows it and finds the lyrics.
player.library.raw_hint: Edit the raw LRC. Saving overwrites the working file; use the Studio for timing.
player.library.restore_confirm: Replace the working text with the saved original?
player.library.delete_confirm: Delete “{title}” from the library? This removes its .lrc and .json files.
player.lyrics.missing: No lyrics found for this track yet.
player.lyrics.error: Lyrics are temporarily unavailable. Retrying shortly.
player.offline: Cannot reach the local server. Is it running?
player.error.player_not_found: That player is no longer available.
player.error.lyrics_unavailable: Lyrics could not be fetched right now.
player.error.request_failed: The local server did not answer.
player.error.library_error: The library could not be loaded or updated.
player.error.no_original: No original is kept for this item.
player.error.invalid_key: That library key is not valid.
lang.label: Language
studio.empty: No lines yet. Add a line, apply raw text, or fetch lyrics.
studio.inspector.empty: Select a line on the timeline or in the list.
studio.notice.migrated: Legacy [end:] tags were converted to ♪ markers. Save to keep the migration.
studio.notice.current_missing: No saved lyrics for the current track yet. Fetch them to start editing.
studio.notice.not_current: This item is not the current track. Playback, preview, and take-current-time work only for the current track.
studio.error.no_seek: The player does not support seeking.
studio.fetch_confirm: Fetch new lyrics from LRCLIB and replace the editor text?
studio.restore_confirm: Replace the editor text with the saved original?
studio.raw.applied: Raw text applied. Save to keep it.
studio.tap.title: Tap mode
studio.tap.hint: Press Space or click Tap at each line start. Backspace undoes the last tap.
studio.tap.ready: Start the countdown, then press Space or tap the big button on each line start.
studio.tap.done: Tap run finished. Check the timeline and save.
studio.tap.needs_seek: Tap mode needs a player that supports seeking.
studio.tap.no_lines: There are no lines to tap.
player.error.no_position: The player has no position yet.
studio.notice.track_changed: The track changed. This document belongs to the previous track; reload the Studio to edit the new one.
